card.name: Numbers inside journal citations
card.fires_on: Digits and punctuation (colons, semicolons, parentheses, spaces) in the volume, issue and page numbers of a journal reference, mostly after JAMA or Arch Surg and a year.

modes.label: Issue and volume punctuation
modes.description: Colon, semicolon or bracket right after a volume or issue number in a JAMA citation.

modes.label: Digits in page or issue numbers
modes.description: A digit within the issue or page range of a reference.

card.plain: It fires on the volume, issue and page numbers in a reference to a medical journal article.
